meta.title: PewPew — meme gunshots for CS2
meta.description: Replace gunshot sounds in CS2 highlights with memes

how.title: How it works
how.lead: A few steps — and your highlight with meme audio is ready.

upload.title: Drop a highlight
upload.body: Drop the clip into the form — we'll take it from there

check.title: Hear what came out
check.body: The shots are already swapped for a short meme. Marker on target — you hear a clean meme; marker off — the meme and the real gunshot hit side by side. All good, hit “Yes, next”; off, hit “No, let me fix” and nudge the markers.
check.alt: Shot track, play button and the “On target?” question

fix.title: Fix the markers if they miss
fix.body: Walk them with “Prev” and “Next”: the track zooms in on each marker and plays it apart from its neighbours. Arrows ← → nudge the selected one, a double-click on a marker removes it, and a double-click on the wave adds a new one.
fix.alt: Zoomed track, marker navigation buttons and the hint

sound.title: Change the meme
sound.body: A short arsenal sound is in by default. Swap it for your own: record a voice clip, grab another meme, or drop a file.
sound.alt: Meme arsenal: tabs and sound cards

loot.title: Take the loot
loot.body: Listen to the whole clip and nudge the meme length if the gunshot tail creeps in.
loot.alt: Summary, preview and the meme-length slider

shotDetection.question: The system detects shots incorrectly
shotDetection.answer: The service is in beta, and the automatic markers do miss sometimes. But you can hear it: on the “Check” step the shots are already swapped for a meme — marker on target, you hear a clean meme; marker off, the meme and the real gunshot hit side by side. Hit “No, let me fix”: you get button-by-button marker navigation, arrows nudge the selected one, and a double-click removes a stray marker or adds a missing one. The more people use it, the faster we learn.

linkOnly.question: I only have a video link, not a file
linkOnly.answerBefore: Sorry — we can't work with video links yet. You can download the video via

videoPrivacy.question: What happens with my video
videoPrivacy.answer: Everything is processed right in your browser — the file is never uploaded to a server or stored anywhere. Close the tab and no trace of it is left.

customSound.question: Can I use my own sound
customSound.answer: Yes. A short arsenal meme is dropped in right away so there is something to listen to on the check step, and you can change it on the “Meme” step: record a voice clip in the browser (up to 5 seconds), grab another arsenal sound, or upload your own file — mp3, wav, ogg, m4a, up to 5 MB.
